author: More Perfect Union
description:
McDonald’s brought in a stunning $27 billion last year just from rent payments.

The biggest secret of McDonald’s success is the money it makes by collecting rent and fees from franchisees, who run 95% of their locations.

And that money acts as a giant cushion, making McDonald’s care less about everything else they do getting worse.

Producer: Sanya Dosani

title: We Uncovered McDonald’s $120 BILLION Real Estate Empire
